explanations: Buckets range 0-99 and the comparison uses <=. At rolloutPercent 0, accounts in bucket 0 (about 1%) are still routed to the secondary gateway, so "0%" never fully turns the rollout off without the kill switch, and every percentage is off by one. It should be bucket < rolloutPercent.
Validation throws while building the local next map, before this.flags is reassigned, so the previous map stays in place and the promise rejects. There is no partial apply, clamping, or clearing.

Routing is recomputed on each charge() call, so after rollback the retry hits the primary gateway. Idempotency keys are scoped per gateway, so the primary sees a new request. Nothing caches routing per invoice, and the amount is unchanged.

isEnabledForAccount returns false whenever killSwitch is true, before looking at the percentage, so every account uses the primary gateway. The config is valid (100 is within range), and there is no per-account stickiness.
